checkpoint.title: From anywhere outdoors: catch a Paras in Mt. Moon B1F, save, heal at Route 4 Center, outdoors

events.why: Fly to Route 4's Pokemon Center, just west of Mt. Moon's main entrance.
Enter Mt. Moon 1F and descend the east ladder to B1F, where 100% of wild encounters are Paras (Lv 5-10).
Catch 1 Paras in Mt. Moon B1F for the Phase 1 Spore catcher.
Save after catching Paras before walking back through Mt. Moon.
Exit Mt. Moon to Route 4 and heal at the Pokemon Center nurse.
Step outdoors outside Route 4's Pokemon Center where 02-train-catchers starts.

metadata.notes: Starts anywhere outdoors in Kanto with at least one free party slot and Ultra Balls, catches a Lv 5-10 Paras in Mt. Moon B1F (100% Paras encounter table in FireRed), saves, heals at Route 4 Center, and steps outdoors.
